pride_data.title: Proteomic profiling of PRLX-93936 and structurally similar compounds in pancreatic cancer cells.
pride_data.projectDescription: To determine the downstream molecular mechanism of PRLX-93936, we performed systematic proteomic profiling of cells treated with PRLX-93936, erastin, or JWZ-8-103. Results include global proteome profiling, ubiquitylation proteomics, and proximity labeling proteomics enabling comparison of drug-induced changes across modalities. This PRIDE entry contains raw proteomics data and FragPipe analyzed search files.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Global Proteome Profiling. WT, TRIM21 KO, or NUP98 sgRNA3 PANC-1 cells were seeded the day prior and treated with DMSO or the indicated. After treatment, cells were detached using trypsin, neutralized with media, and washed twice. The samples were denatured in 8 M urea-based lysis buffer, reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP and 40 mM chloroacetamide, then digested overnight with Trypsin/Lys-C, acidified, desalted, and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.  Ubiquitylation Proteomics. Following cellular treatment and digestion as described above, desalted digested peptides were enriched via immunoaffinity purification with the PTMScan® Ubiquitin Remnant Motif (K-ε-GG) Kit #5562 (CST) following the kit’s procedure. The enriched peptides were desalted again and then analyzed by LC-MS/MS.  Proximity Labeling Proteomics. PANC-1 TRIM21 KO cells were stably transduced with TRIM21-TurboID and treated with proteasomal inhibitor MG132, then compound or DMSO, and finally biotin. Following RIPA buffer lysis, biotinylated proteins were enriched with streptavidin beads and then subsequently digested with Trypsin/Lys-C Protease using DTT and iodoacetamide for reduction and alkylation. The peptides were then desalted and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.  LC-MS/MS analysis. Peptides were analyzed using a nanoElute 2 UHPLC coupled to a timsTOF HT via a CaptiveSpray nano-electrospray source using an Aurora column (25 cm x 75 µm ID, 1.7 µm) over a 70 min gradient. diaPASEF was perofmed using 25 Da windows from mass range 226.8 Da to 1226.8 Da and mobility range 0.70 1/K0 to 1.30 1/K0.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: The raw diaPASEF files were processed using library-free analysis in FragPipe 22.0 using diaTracer for spectrum-centric spectral library generation from diaPASEF scans and quantification using DIA-NN 1.9.1 with 0.1% FDR and and QuantUMS high accuracy settings. The reviewed human proteome (UniProt UP000005640, 07/13/2024) with decoys and contaminants was used. Methionine oxidiation and N-terminal acetylation were set as variable modifications with cysteine carbamidomethylation set as a fixed modification. For ubiquitylation proteomics, the K-ε-GG remnant (UniMod 121) was included as a variable modification. For validation, MSBooster (DIA-NN model) and Percolator were used for RT and MS/MS spectra prediction and PSM rescoring, while ProtienProphet (--maxppmdiff 2000000) was used for protein inference with FDR filtering (--picked --prot 0.01). Statistical analysis was performed in R, which included additional peptide filtering: (i) 1% FDR filtering at the global.q.value (precursor Q value across all samples), (ii) quantification of a given peptide in at least two replicates in one condition, and (iii) removal of singly charged peptides and non-proteotypic (unique) peptides. Protein or ubiquitylation site MaxLFQ intensities were recalculated from the remaining peptides. Differential statistics was then performed using the DEqMS R package, which performs a LIMMA-moderated t-test with an adjustment for number of detected peptides per ubiquitylation site, to determine the p-value, fold change, and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value.
